# Dto — Evidence

## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-parser-dto.acf782fb"></a>**1. ParsedEventDto is a data transfer object that represents a parsed event, carrying fields for a unique identifier, module code, activity type, optional group, day and date, start and end times, venue, and a recurring flag.**
  [`parsed-event.dto.ts:10-71`](../parsed-event.dto.ts#L10-L71)
- <a id="research.backend-src-parser-dto.e0cd8a63"></a>**2. The DTO validates its fields with class-validator decorators: id must be a UUID, startTime and endTime must match the HH:MM format, isRecurring must be a boolean, and the remaining fields must be strings.**
  [`parsed-event.dto.ts:11-70`](../parsed-event.dto.ts#L11-L70)
- <a id="research.backend-src-parser-dto.a7c3ae29"></a>**3. The unit backend/src/parser/dto contains a single source file, parsed-event.dto.ts, which defines the exported class ParsedEventDto.**
  [`parsed-event.dto.ts:10-71`](../parsed-event.dto.ts#L10-L71)
- <a id="research.backend-src-parser-dto.6b15c218"></a>**4. The DTO documents its fields for OpenAPI/Swagger using ApiProperty and ApiPropertyOptional decorators from @nestjs/swagger.**
  [`parsed-event.dto.ts:1-1`](../parsed-event.dto.ts#L1-L1)
  [`parsed-event.dto.ts:11-70`](../parsed-event.dto.ts#L11-L70)
- <a id="research.backend-src-parser-dto.6d90d151"></a>**5. The fields id, module, activity, startTime, endTime, venue and isRecurring are required, while group, day and date are optional.**
  [`parsed-event.dto.ts:10-70`](../parsed-event.dto.ts#L10-L70)
